creator: mr.paidsocial
title: Grok Bot setup for existing Claude Code/Codex users: make Grok Bot the execution layer that delegates to Claude Code on your own subscription, link machines with Tailscale, and build a 'librarian' bot that catalogs every past project/skill folder on a Mac mini

tools.name: Grok Bot
tools.detail: xAI agent platform with a 'team' of named bots (Opi, Libby, Chatty Cathy, Carol, Ditto, Genny, Marge, Velcro)

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.detail: logged in inside Grok Bot's own browser/terminal; does the actual work on the existing Anthropic plan

tools.name: Tailscale
tools.detail: mesh VPN: Mac mini, MacBook Pro, iPhone and the Grok Bot agent each get a Tailscale IP

tools.name: ManyChat
tools.detail: Instagram DM automation flow built by Claude via Grok Bot

tools.name: LeadShark
tools.detail: 'LeadShark for LinkedIn' listed in bot chat

tools.name: Mac mini
tools.detail: holds the 'AI Projects' folder of every Claude Code / Codex project

claims: Grok Bot can be configured so its built-in LLM is only the execution layer while Claude Code or Codex does the work, cutting Grok Bot usage and leveraging plans already paid for
One bot (Opi, operations manager) was told to share the setup with every other bot on the team
Grok Bot summarizes what Claude Code is doing under the hood
With Tailscale every machine plus the Grok Bot agent are on one network; the agent can control the Mac mini
Libby the 'database librarian' scraped the entire AI Projects folder (every markdown and skill) into a library catalog other bots query
how_to_steps: In Grok Bot, log into Claude in the bot's own browser and authenticate Claude Code in its own terminal

Tell the bot: 'I want to use Claude Code to run all my tasks within Grok Bot. The built-in LLM will only be the execution layer. Your job is to make sure this happens.' Then tell it to share this setup with all other bots
Have the ops bot set up Tailscale on Mac mini, MacBook Pro, iPhone and the Grok Bot agent
Create a 'librarian' bot with access to the Mac mini's projects folder; have it scrape every markdown/skill into a catalog
Point other bots at the librarian when they need a tool or file location
Example task: ask the DM bot to build a new ManyChat flow; Claude maps it, Grok Bot reports
on_screen_only: Caption 'THE ONLY WAY TO USE GROK BOT'

Bot roster: Carol - Carousel Builder; Ditto - Content Manager; Genny - AI Content Creator; Opi - Operations Manager; Libby - Database Librarian; Marge - Head of Margin; Velcro - Community Manager; Chatty Cathy - DM Automation Manager

Chat lines: 'What's the main thing you want me handling?' / 'Got it. ManyChat for Instagram DMs, LeadShark for LinkedIn. Checking in with Libby now so I start on the right stack.' / 'Claude's mapping the ManyChat and LeadShark setup'
Scheduled task 'Reconnect Tailscale -- Weekdays at 8:15 AM'; prompt 'ok what do we need to make tailscale always work'
Mac mini with an external Samsung SSD; neon 'MR. PAID S...' sign

gap.what: Liked set has grokbot (gov-contracting founder) and Karen Cheng's Grok bot, but not the 'orchestrator delegates to Claude Code on your existing plan' pattern, Tailscale mesh for agent-to-machine access, or a librarian agent that indexes all past project folders/skills.

relevance.why: The librarian-indexing-your-skills idea and Tailscale remote access are transferable to Haji's own Claude Code/Cowork setup even without Grok Bot; Grok Bot itself is another subscription.

implement_score.why: Skip Grok Bot. Worth doing: a Claude Code skill or Cowork task that catalogs all project folders/skills into a searchable index (Karpathy-wiki style), and Tailscale if remote Mac access is needed.

verify: Is routing Grok Bot through a Claude Code login allowed under Anthropic's consumer terms?
Security of giving a hosted agent Tailscale access to a Mac mini with all projects
